# Vendored browser libraries

The following browser builds are distributed unchanged. Keep their original
copyright headers and the accompanying upstream license texts when copying the
frontend. The asset installer includes these notices and licenses in its copy set.

## Marked 18.1.2

- Project: <https://github.com/markedjs/marked>
- Browser build: <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@18.1.2/lib/marked.umd.js>
- Upstream license: <https://github.com/markedjs/marked/blob/v18.1.2/LICENSE>
- Local license: [marked-LICENSE.txt](marked-LICENSE.txt), retained in full including Markdown attribution.
- Build copyright: MarkedJS (2018–2026) and Christopher Jeffrey (2011–2018); MIT License.
- SHA-256 of `marked.umd.js`: `9eb730d2362ae1a8c6201698f17009e16671be6946d3d06503ddc0575283db7c`

## DOMPurify 3.4.17

- Project: <https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify>
- Browser build: <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3.4.17/dist/purify.min.js>
- Upstream licenses: <https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/blob/3.4.17/LICENSE> and <https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/blob/3.4.17/LICENSE-MPL>.
- Local texts: [Apache 2.0](DOMPurify-LICENSE-APACHE.txt) and [MPL 2.0](DOMPurify-LICENSE-MPL.txt), both retained.
- Build copyright: Cure53 and other contributors.
- SHA-256 of `purify.min.js`: `cd37898f9782adf54820c413191b5691803f0f137c799d6edcfd38523b4c2c31`

Both builds reference optional source maps, which are not bundled and are not
required to run the chat. No package-manager installation or runtime CDN download
is needed for these local scripts. Update pinned builds and this record together.
